messages:
sam: Heads-up — mainline CI is red right after PR #4128 merged. gpu-smoke and kv-cache-test failing. pipeline: https://ci.redwood.com/teams/infra/pipelines/9876/builds/1234 :warning:
mei: ack. who's the merge author?
sam: @nina merged it (commit a1b2c3d).
alex: pinging @nina and @zach. can someone rerun the failing jobs first?
nina: on it, kicking rerun for gpu-smoke and kv-cache-test.
deploy-bot: Re-run requested by nina for jobs [gpu-smoke, kv-cache-test] — started (build 1234.1).
zach: if rerun fails we should bisect fast. feel free to tag me.
ci-bot: gpu-smoke failed with OOM on shard 2. Log excerpt:
```
E tensorflow: GPU alloc failed: out of memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/gpu_smoke_test.py", line 142, in run_smoke
    allocate_buffers()
  OSError: [Errno 12] Cannot allocate memory
```
mei: OOM could be unrelated to merge. Any change touching batch size or memory hints?
sam: checkout diff — PR touched model-serving batch scheduler configs. could be related.
nina: rerun done: gpu-smoke still failed, kv-cache-test passed. gpu-smoke failing consistently on shard 2.
alex: can someone try a rerun with reduced parallelism on that job? adding env REDWOOD_GPU_PARALLEL=1
nina: started rerun with env override. deploy-bot: Re-run requested by nina (gpu-smoke, env override) — started (build 1234.2).
oncall: if this keeps failing and blocks main, we should revert PR 4128 to restore green.
zach: I can bisect — will start git bisect between main~10 and main to find offending commit if reruns keep failing.
ci-bot: build 1234.2 results: gpu-smoke passed on shard 2. Looks flaky.
sam: ok passing now. let's not revert. create a bug to track flaky gpu-smoke and add test tag to quarantine.
mei: created issue INFRA-789: 'flaky gpu-smoke shard 2 after PR 4128' — assigned to zach. link: https://issues.redwood.com/INFRA-789
nina: will follow up PR with reduced batch defaults and add stress test.
alex: thanks all. I'll mark the pipeline as resolved in the incident channel and add a note in release board.
zach: I'll run local stress tests and post results later today.
deploy-bot: Pipeline 9876 build 1234 marked resolved by sam.
